name: Minnesota

flag.description: A light blue field with a dark blue shape at the hoist, echoing the outline of the state, holding a white eight-pointed star.
flag.symbolism: The star stands for the North Star and the state motto "L'Étoile du Nord"; the light blue stands for Minnesota's many lakes and rivers.

hook: Minnesota's new flag is a white North Star in a dark blue, state-shaped block against a light blue field, with no seal at all.
trivia: The flag was adopted on Statehood Day, 11 May 2024, replacing a seal-on-blue design in use since 1957.
It was developed by a state commission from a public submission by Andrew Prekker.
